description: Membership of the African Union and the regional bodies, and suspensions from participation (schema/memberships.py). Proposals are research from the bodies' sources and the treaties, read on 2026-10-21; they are never served. Only rows a reviewer has approved are published.

basis.instrument: Constitutive Act of the African Union
basis.quote: 2. The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the OAU. 3. Any Member State of the OAU acceding to this Act after its entry into force shall deposit the instrument of accession with the Chairman of the Commission.

memberships.note: The AU's status list (15 June 2017) gives: signature 2001-03-01, ratification or accession 2001-09-19, deposit 2001-12-20. It deposited after the Act's entry into force on 26 May 2001 (Article 28), so its membership starts on its deposit; the Act states no later date of entry into force for a state that deposits after that day. The OAU is a different, predecessor body: its membership is not this one. The Union's launch at Durban on 9 July 2002 is not a start date.

basis.instrument: Constitutive Act of the African Union
basis.quote: Admission shall be decided by a simple majority of the Member States.

memberships.note: Admitted under Article 29 by the Assembly's Decision on the Admission of the Kingdom of Morocco to the African Union, Assembly/AU/Dec.639(XXVIII), para. 4, at its 28th Ordinary Session (Addis Ababa, 30-31 January 2017); the decision's text gives the session, and the AU Handbook 2023 gives the day of the decision, 30 January 2017 (https://au.int/sites/default/files/documents/31829-doc-African_Union_Handbook_2023_ENGLISH.pdf). The AU's status list (15 June 2017) gives: no signature, ratification or accession 2017-01-20, deposit 2017-01-31. The deposit of its instrument of accession, on 31 January 2017, followed the decision. The 1963 date on the AU's country profile is the OAU's. The OAU is a different, predecessor body: its membership is not this one. The Union's launch at Durban on 9 July 2002 is not a start date.
